description: When ICE descended on southwest Kansas in another whirlwind of immigration enforcement activity, Kansas politicians urged federal agents against such community disruption and concern for safety. Lauren Reinhold stated that snatching Kansans from the street is an extreme overstep of ICE's jurisdiction, and vowed to halt this pattern. However, Tracey Mann had no comment.https://1350kman.com/2026/09/politicians-caution-federal-immigration-agents-in-southwest-kansas/
paid_for_by: sponsored by the Hutchinson/Reno County Chamber of Commerce, where voters came to hear candidates' positions on the issues important to Kansans
title: Bipartisan Kansas Politicians Stand Against Government Abuses in Immigration Actions
